residual_risks: Original official www DNS remains unchanged until preview review and deliberate cutover.
127 uncategorized unrelated/spam-like legacy posts are retained privately for review, not published by default; original backup is not deleted.
External SMTP delivery is not configured or demonstrated; intake persists in admin.
WordPress historical private inquiries/accounts are backed up but not imported into the new CMS.
Five unused source assets already return404 on the original; third-party Vimeo/provider uptime remains external.
Visual equality is measured at finite viewports with timing-dependent sliders/videos; do not interpret measured ratios as universal 100% identity.
Locally served originals can differ slightly from Photon CDN image resizing/cropping; animation/video timing and finite viewport measurements do not establish universal pixel equality.
